description: The canonical TrueSeal FFI surface (ADR-0028, amended by ADR-0032 and ADR-0034) — the G12 parity check compares errors/events/issues across the three SDKs against this file. GENERATED by `cargo run --bin gen-shared-facts` from trueseal_sync::surface (SYNC-21) — never edit by hand; ffi::tests::the_ffi_surface_matches_api_surface_json and CI both fail on drift. HandlerError (the message handler's own failure type) is deliberately NOT part of this surface: it is thrown BY the app into the library, never raised BY the library.
